# Codementee — MAANG Interview Prep Platform
# https://codementee.io
# llms.txt — AI-readable site summary for LLM crawlers

## What is Codementee?

Codementee is an interview preparation platform for software engineers targeting MAANG (Meta, Apple, Amazon, Netflix, Google) and top product companies. It combines live mock interviews with MAANG engineers, AI-powered job search, and free learning courses.

## Core Products

### Mock Interviews
- Live 1:1 mock interviews with MAANG engineers
- Detailed feedback reports on communication, problem-solving, and technical depth
- Covers: System Design, DSA/Coding, Behavioral, DevOps/SRE
- Plans: Starter (₹2,999 / 1 mock), Pro (₹6,999 / 3 mocks), Elite (₹14,999 / 6 mocks)

### 1:1 Mentorship
- Personalized mentorship sessions with engineers from Google, Amazon, Meta
- Career strategy, resume review, referral guidance

### AI Job Search Agent
- AI-powered job discovery based on resume and preferences
- Searches Google Jobs, RemoteOK, Jobicy in real-time
- Scores and ranks jobs by skill match, location, and experience fit
- Plans: Monthly (₹199), Quarterly (₹499), Yearly (₹1,499)

### Resume Review
- Resume review by MAANG engineers
- ATS optimization, formatting, and content feedback

## Free Learning Courses

### System Design Course
- URL: https://codementee.io/learn/system-design
- 50+ topics covering distributed systems, databases, caching, sharding, CAP theorem, design patterns
- Free Quick Start section (6 topics) for all logged-in users
- Premium sections (Fundamentals, Interview Questions, Advanced) require Pro/Elite plan
- Includes step-by-step walkthroughs of real interview questions: Design Bit.ly, Design YouTube, Design Uber, Design WhatsApp, Design Instagram, Design Google Docs

### DevOps Course
- URL: https://codementee.io/learn/devops
- 64 topics: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Terraform, Ansible, Helm, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD, AWS, monitoring
- Includes 30-day MAANG-ready roadmap
- Real scenario-based interview questions
- Price: ₹499 one-time (lifetime access)

### Linux Course
- URL: https://codementee.io/learn/linux
- 33 topics: kernel, file system, permissions, grep/sed/awk, processes, networking, shell scripting
- 44 MAANG-level interview questions organized by category (CPU, memory, disk, network)
- 8 real-world production debugging scenarios
- 7-day quick start + 2-week advanced roadmap
- Free with login

### DSA Patterns Course
- URL: https://codementee.io/learn/dsa-patterns
- 180+ LeetCode problems organized by 22 patterns
- Company tags (Google, Amazon, Meta, etc.)
- Progress tracking
- Free with login

### Behavioral Interview Prep
- URL: https://codementee.io/learn/behavioral
- 80+ questions with STAR method examples
- Covers Amazon Leadership Principles, Meta values, conflict resolution
- Free with login

### Linux Playground
- URL: https://codementee.io/learn/linux/playground
- Interactive simulated Linux terminal in the browser
- Practice grep, sed, awk, ps, df, curl, and 30+ commands
- Pre-loaded sample files: nginx access logs, /etc/passwd, CSV data, shell scripts

## Target Audience
- Software engineers preparing for MAANG interviews
- Freshers and 0-3 year experience engineers targeting top companies
- DevOps/SRE engineers preparing for infrastructure interviews
- Engineers looking for referrals and job opportunities at top companies

## Key Differentiators
- Real MAANG engineers as interviewers (not AI-only)
- AI job search that finds real jobs from Google Jobs, not just AI-generated listings
- Free courses with premium interview question breakdowns
- India-focused pricing (₹499 - ₹14,999 range)

## Contact & Social
- Website: https://codementee.io
- Platform: React frontend, Python/FastAPI backend, MongoDB
